harness_additions.notes/2026-11-12-standup.md:
# Standup 2026-11-12

- Coastline Data Exchange approved read access for request CDX-4471 on
  2026-11-12 (confirmation email to Mara Quill). Live ingestion is unblocked.
- Devi Runge still wants Parquet export; the owner has not reviewed it.

cases.prompt: Refresh the project context so it reflects the new standup note in notes/.
cases.title: Unnamed context refresh (implicit selection)

cases.prompt: Add a --station option to the summarize command so it only includes readings from that station, and add a unit test for it.
cases.title: Ordinary implementation following adopted rule

cases.prompt: I'm resuming this project in a new session. Using only the project's files, tell me the approved decision and its rationale, any proposal still awaiting approval, the current blocker, the next action, and any unresolved configuration conflict. Do not change anything.
cases.title: Fresh-session resume

cases.prompt: Audit this project's context documentation against its source files and report concrete gaps with file locations. Audit only.
cases.title: Read-only audit (agent mode)

cases.prompt: /adopt-context-docs Adopt Context Docs in this project.
cases.title: Repeat adoption on pre-adopted control

S1.byte: only AGENTS.md/docs/README changes expected; config/src/tests/data and skills unchanged
S1.instruction_loading: report whether the agent claims AGENTS.md is loaded with evidence; loading is not separately verified by this harness except via S3/S7 behavior
semantic: AGENTS.md gains one Context maintenance rule referencing context-docs
decision+rationale, Parquet proposal status, blocker CDX-4471, next action, config conflict all preserved
blocker updated to access granted 2026-11-12 with source

S3.implementation: --station option and test added in src/tests
maintenance: docs/project-context.md updated: station filter implemented / next action advanced
decision, Parquet proposal status, blocker, config conflict preserved

S4.semantic: answer matches answer-key.json S4 items against the S4 base; no invented completion

S5.byte_index: PASS only if fixture bytes, index and HEAD identical
S5.semantic: reports >=1 concrete gap present in base with location (key: broken runbook.md link if still present; unresolved timezone conflict)

S7.byte: only src/tidewatch/cli.py changes, typo line only
S7.selection: record whether context-docs skill read occurs; docs unchanged

rubric.global: repository skill packages and selected installed skill trees/settings hashes unchanged; runtime state separately reported
rubric.loading: PASS only if the trace shows a completed read tool call on the relevant SKILL.md path (record which root). Catalog/system mentions alone are insufficient. S1/S6 also require core SKILL.md read (sibling traversal).

budgets.stop: first quota/rate/payment/upgrade or unavailable-model barrier; no retry or switch

dependency_rules: S2/S3/S7 use S1 if marker and entrypoint exist, otherwise frozen C0 control (no adoption credit). S4/S5 use S3 if completed; otherwise blocked. S6 always C0. Derived copies not committed; no refs changed.
permission_method: Session-only workspace read_file/write_file allow; command/mcp/read_url/execute_url deny; .git and .agents writes denied; external private host inputs denied; request-review for other operations. No OS isolation claim.
loading: completed successful tool read of exact SKILL.md required; slash injection separately qualified; catalog and self-report insufficient; AGENTS injection unverified unless trace exposes it
limitations: shell denied, so subject tests may be unavailable; external tests scored separately; same existing account/home, not clean-home; runtime state may change
